A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Riverwood
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Character: single-detached homes under RS1, RS2, RS3 and RS4 zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630, in an established neighbourhood per the OCP, with a strong built townhome component.
Lot sizes, as the bylaw states them: RS zone minimum lot widths run from at least 9.5 m (RS4) to at least 30 m (RS3) — RS1 at least 15 m, RS2 at least 12 m.
Tenure: detached homes are freehold; townhomes are strata titled.
Serviced position: city stock is on municipal water and sewer, billed as flat annual water and sewer fees, billed separately and due March 31, 2026.
ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR land was confirmed inside Riverwood — the ground is urban north-east PoCo. ALR status remains a per-parcel check on ALC mapping, and no ALR split is stated.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Riverwood

items.t: Riverwood is an established residential neighbourhood on the north-east side of the City of Port Coquitlam, around Riverwood Gate and Coast Meridian Road by the Pitt River; Terry Fox Secondary School is at 1260 Riverwood Gate. "Riverwood" is also the board (GVR) sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report, and the City's Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 3838) names Riverwood and Citadel Heights as established residential neighbourhoods.
Nearby areas: Citadel PQ to the west, Mary Hill to the south, the Dominion Avenue and Fremont growth areas further east, and Pitt Meadows across the Pitt River.

Roads and transit: Coast Meridian Road and Riverwood Gate serve the area, connecting south to Lougheed Highway and the Pitt River Bridge corridor toward Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge. TransLink buses connect to Port Coquitlam Station (West Coast Express) and Coquitlam Central Station (Millennium Line).

Parks, recreation and health: the Traboulay PoCo Trail passes the Pitt River side of the city near Riverwood, and City parks in the wider north-east include Fortress Park at 2698 Fortress Court; Hyde Creek Recreation Centre at 1379 Laurier Avenue serves the north side, and the Terry Fox Library is at the Port Coquitlam Community Centre, 2150 Wilson Avenue. The nearest hospital is Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody (Fraser Health).
Flood position: land toward the Pitt River is low-lying, and a significant portion of the city is within the Fraser and Pitt River floodplain behind dykes.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Riverwood

items.t: City plan: Port Coquitlam's Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 3838, which names Riverwood and Citadel Heights as established residential neighbourhoods; no Riverwood-specific major project was confirmed pass.

Zoning and SSMUH, as the City states it: Zoning Bylaw No. 3630 (2008) governs — single-detached homes under RS1–RS4 (minimum lot widths at least 15 m RS1, 12 m RS2, 30 m RS3, 9.5 m RS4), townhouse zones RTh1, RTh2 and RTh3 in the bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Riverwood ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

Port Coquitlam property taxes and utilities: property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on current taxes unpaid after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; the City's 2026 increase was 1.95% for the average home, and the City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver; utility bills are flat annual water and sewer fees, billed separately and due March 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Riverwood

items.t: The same developer sells and rents on the same street. Mosaic built Fremont Green (550 Seaborne Place, strata, 2014), the rental building next door at 553 Seaborne Place, and Dominion's rowhomes/townhouses at Avon Place in the same Fremont pocket — a buyer comparing "Fremont" or "Dominion" addresses has to establish which tenure each address is before comparing anything.

Riverwood's attached market is its fast lane, but none of it is land. The sub-area's 38% attached sales ratio in September 2026 was the strongest of any Port Coquitlam sub-area that month — in general-market townhome complexes, on built strata lots.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Riverwood

items.t: Single-detached homes sit under RS1, RS2, RS3 and RS4 zones, and townhouse zones RTh1, RTh2 and RTh3 exist in the bylaw.

The City permits secondary suites only in the RS-1, RS-2, RS-3 and RS-4 zones, and a building permit is required; the City waives 50% of the extra suite utility levy when the suite is occupied by a parent or grandparent, and waives it entirely when a paid caregiver lives in the suite to care for a permanently disabled owner or family member.

blocks.text: Riverwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

66 townhomes sold in Riverwood with a median price of $881,750 (the middle half sold between $816,250 and $975,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $581 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $395 a month. 15 houses sold in Riverwood with a median price of $1,410,000 (the middle half sold between $1,330,000 and $1,510,000), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 13% sold above list. They had a median $629 per square foot, a median year built of 1997 and a median lot of 4,617 square feet.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Riverwood?

faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25% on only 8 listed, too few to read as a market type; condos and townhomes had 64% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.a: 5 houses and 41 condos and townhomes sold in Riverwood over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in September with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 10 sold.

faq.a: In October 2026, Riverwood held 5.8% of the 137 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 6.4% of the 219 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 36.4% of the 22 homes listed in Riverwood and condos and townhomes made up 63.6%; of the 11 that sold, houses were 18.2% and condos and townhomes 81.8%.
